objective: Verify intended frontend/backend URL, HTTPS/origins and browser-visible requests
preconditions: Build configured for intended public backend; approved test deployment
steps: Open Network; load login and settings; check request origin without copying cookie values
pass_criteria: Requests reach intended backend; no undefined URL, mixed-content, CORS or trusted-Origin failures
required_evidence: Browser/version; frontend origin; backend origin; final image/source identity

preconditions: Successful build; no server already owns chosen port
steps: Copy public and .next/static into standalone; start server.js; load four routes
pass_criteria: HTML, CSS and JS load; console has no application exceptions
required_evidence: Startup log and route screenshots

preconditions: Synthetic test account; intended backend
steps: Review desktop/mobile light/dark; type a multiline draft; use sidebar/menu
pass_criteria: No clipped controls or unintended horizontal page scroll; layout and controls usable
required_evidence: Four screenshots; viewport and theme

preconditions: Synthetic response with headings/list/code/citation content
steps: Review rendered Markdown/code in desktop/mobile and light/dark
pass_criteria: Readable colors; code scrolling stays in code area; no overlap or missing styles
required_evidence: Screenshots and content fixture description

preconditions: Signed-out browser context
steps: Review all viewports/themes; trigger empty/invalid input validation
pass_criteria: Labels, help, errors and buttons remain readable and operable
required_evidence: Screenshots and keyboard notes

objective: Project list, create dialog and settings
preconditions: Disposable synthetic project only
steps: Review search/empty/list/create and settings/conflict/delete dialog
pass_criteria: No clipping; field labels/errors and confirmation controls visible
required_evidence: Screenshots for each interaction

preconditions: Synthetic account; synthetic integration configuration
steps: Review tabs, scope dropdown, disabled/enabled controls, errors and save notices
pass_criteria: Usable dropdowns, focus styles, scrolling and disabled states
required_evidence: Screenshots, including mobile dropdown

preconditions: Desktop browser; app pages loaded
steps: Tab/Shift+Tab through forms and dialogs; Escape where supported; inspect at 200% zoom
pass_criteria: Visible focus; intended dialog behavior; essential controls remain accessible
required_evidence: Navigation notes, screenshots at zoom

preconditions: Disposable account A; actual backend
steps: Sign in through UI; confirm /auth/me identity privately; hard reload
pass_criteria: Account remains verified after reload; no cached-only authentication
required_evidence: Redacted status/timing evidence; no passwords or cookie values

preconditions: Authenticated test session; agreed deployment policy available
steps: Inspect session cookie in browser Application/Storage panel
pass_criteria: HttpOnly and scope/lifetime match backend policy; Secure/SameSite match intended deployment
required_evidence: Attribute names/booleans only; redact cookie values

preconditions: Authenticated account A
steps: Logout normally; reload; open protected project/settings views
pass_criteria: Local private state clears; backend session not accepted after logout
required_evidence: Logout and /auth/me status; screenshots

preconditions: Disposable account A; browser-only request blocking
steps: Block /v1/auth/logout in DevTools; logout; observe; unblock and click Retry logout
pass_criteria: Truthful local-clear/server-uncertain message; retry submits logout rather than /me; confirmed result clears uncertainty
required_evidence: Network method/path/status and message screenshots

preconditions: Disposable account A; browser-only request blocking
steps: Block /v1/auth/me; reload; inspect protected views; unblock and retry verification
pass_criteria: No old private account state shown; verification error differs from anonymous; recovery restores verified account
required_evidence: Error/recovery screenshots and redacted network statuses

preconditions: Disposable backend with known safe test TTL, or natural expiry
steps: Wait for actual backend expiry; navigate/revalidate; attempt protected action
pass_criteria: Expired cookie does not authorize operation; UI recovers via sign-in without old state leakage
required_evidence: Configured TTL reference, timestamps and 401 evidence; deleting a cookie is not actual-expiry evidence

preconditions: Dedicated test Google account; intended HTTPS callback/origins
steps: Complete sign-in via UI; reload; logout; repeat cancel/deny flow
pass_criteria: Correct callback/account; no tokens in URL fragment; cancelled flow does not show success
required_evidence: Redacted redirect hosts/statuses; never capture provider credentials or state values

objective: A to B private state isolation
preconditions: Two disposable accounts A/B with distinct synthetic projects/settings
steps: Use A; open drafts/dialog; logout and login B in same browser context
pass_criteria: A projects, chats, settings drafts, credentials and notices disappear; B has own state
required_evidence: Before/after screenshots with synthetic markers

objective: Late project list/detail read after account switch
preconditions: A/B and network throttling; no production data
steps: Throttle read until pending; logout/login B; allow A response to finish
pass_criteria: Late A data cannot populate B view
required_evidence: Network timing plus B screenshots; mark blocked if race not reproduced

preconditions: Disposable projects; throttled response demonstrably in flight
steps: Start synthetic mutation under A; switch identity where UI permits; let response finish
pass_criteria: No A-origin navigation/success/conflict/error affects B; server outcome checked separately
required_evidence: Timing/network and final view; do not infer server rollback from browser abort

preconditions: Disposable accounts with synthetic settings; never real provider secrets
steps: Delay A settings read/save; replace account; let response finish
pass_criteria: No A form/flags/success notice applied to B
required_evidence: Redacted settings markers, network timing, B flags

preconditions: A/B in same context
steps: Set distinct compact/source preferences for A and B; reload/switch each
pass_criteria: Each account restores only its own allowed preferences; no legacy-key import
required_evidence: Preference key names/boolean values only; no secret cache export

preconditions: Account A; synthetic project/draft
steps: Navigate using app links; use browser Back/Forward; navigate during a pending read
pass_criteria: No stale page completion alters new route; private data remains scoped
required_evidence: Route sequence and screenshots; not just direct hard reloads

preconditions: Synthetic editable project
steps: Edit without saving; navigate by app links, Back/Forward, reload and closing tab
pass_criteria: Behavior matches approved draft-loss contract; no silent persistence or false Saved notice
required_evidence: Record each navigation mechanism; a unit pass does not prove guards

preconditions: Synthetic chat with no external write tools
steps: Start stream; navigate away; return; test controlled failure and explicit latest-turn retry
pass_criteria: No old tokens/progress affect new page; one local user turn on retry; no claim of server cancellation
required_evidence: Redacted messages/status and route timing

preconditions: Same synthetic project in two tabs as A
steps: Load revision in both; save in tab1 then save stale tab2
pass_criteria: Conflict distinguished; tab2 draft preserved and success not falsely shown; explicit reload works
required_evidence: Revision/status metadata and draft screenshot

objective: Final source frozen and published on both remotes
preconditions: Explicit user authorization for commit/publication; safe staging reviewed
steps: Record final commit; verify both remote branch SHAs equal it
pass_criteria: Both remotes identify same final commit with no missing generated sources
required_evidence: Commit SHA and read-only ls-remote output

preconditions: Final commit published; Actions enabled
steps: Run/observe Frontend acceptance evidence for final commit; download individual evidence files from artifact
pass_criteria: All intended stages execute; summary passed/sourceUnchanged true; commit matches
required_evidence: Run URL, attempt, job logs, summary and source manifests

preconditions: Same commit; pipeline enabled; runner prerequisites met
steps: Validate YAML; run/observe frontend-acceptance; collect artifacts
pass_criteria: Same commands and commit; standalone/container checks executed, not skipped
required_evidence: Pipeline/job URL, commit, runner details, summary/manifests

preconditions: Both completed artifact sets available locally
steps: Compare commit, source fingerprint, executed steps, audits and smoke checks
pass_criteria: Matching source; both run all gates; no new audit IDs; differences explained
required_evidence: Comparison record; do not require identical images/build hashes across environments

preconditions: Named maintainer and reviewer; actual source and tests available
steps: Review hashes, parser/AST limits, cycles, install hooks, direct APIs, bypass/failure modes
pass_criteria: Named owner approves maintenance; reviewer records findings/resolution; no assertion of complete sandboxing
required_evidence: Written review, owner approval, limitations and review triggers

preconditions: Lockfile/version evidence; both advisory records
steps: Compare installed 6.1.5 and maintainer patched range with central audit; document chosen policy
pass_criteria: Explicitly approved code-remediation/scanner disposition or blocked decision; not falsely marked audit-clean
required_evidence: Advisory evidence and signed disposition

preconditions: Supported-version/peer-range metadata and current warning
steps: Assign owner and compatible remediation plan; review impact before upgrade
pass_criteria: Support issue has approved disposition/owner/date; not called fixed merely because lint passes
required_evidence: Owner, plan, due/review date and approval

preconditions: Required technical gates and review records complete
steps: Complete external final-signoff record against final commit/fingerprint and CI URLs
pass_criteria: Authorized person signs actual approve/reject/restricted decision; incomplete gates remain explicit
required_evidence: Signed record outside hashed source tree; no auto-generated signature
